Left: Richard Hunter made his debut for Belgrave on September 7th 1991 at New River Stadium, Haringey, placing 2nd in the 'B' 110m hurdles in a legal pb of 15.04. He also clocked 49.96 in the 'B' 400m. Sharing a joke behind him are Belgrave's Ian Wells and Haringey's Dalton Grant.
Above: Ian Wells can now add "Team Manager" to his long list of events
